content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Serving officers who meet the eligibility conditions may apply through proper channel, on offline mode, in the prescribed proforma. Completed applications should be sent to: Director (A&P), Delhi Jal Board, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, 2nd Floor, Room No. 202, Varunalaya Phase-II, Jhandewalan, Karol Bagh, Delhi-110005. Applications received after the expiry of 30 days from the date of publication shall not be entertained, and an application received after the closing date is liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The eligibility conditions come from Section 3(2)(VII) and (VIII) of the Delhi Water Board Act, 1998, and are open to serving officers of the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories, Public Sector Undertakings and Autonomous Organisations. Must be an engineer drawing pay not less than that of a Joint Secretary to the Government of India. Must have specialized knowledge and experience in the matters relating to water supply. Must be an engineer drawing pay scale not less than that of a Joint Secretary to the Government of India. Must have specialized knowledge and experience in the matters related to drainage. The notice does not name a specific degree; it requires the candidate to be an engineer as described above. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post. The pay of the officials selected will be regulated with DoP&T Order No. 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay II), New Delhi dated 17 June, 2010 (amended from time to time). In addition to pay, DA/HRA and other allowances are payable as admissible to the employees of the Corporation. Nomination is initially for the period of three years. The officer nominated would be termed on deputation and will be governed by standard terms and conditions of deputation as applicable from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed proforma (Annex-A). Two passport size photographs. Vigilance Clearance and vigilance status. No Objection Certificate (NOC). Integrity Certificate. Attested copies of APARs/ACRs for the last five years. Attested photocopies of educational certificates and experience. Certificate from the Head of Organization confirming the particulars, that no disciplinary/vigilance proceedings are pending or contemplated, the officer's integrity, any penalties imposed, recommendation of the application and that the officer will be relieved if selected.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through screening and an interview, if one is held. Mere fulfilment of educational qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview; the Screening Committee will adopt its own criteria for holding the interview. At the interview, if any, candidates should bring original testimonials of all qualifications and experience in the relevant area over and above the minimum prescribed qualification. A "No Objection Certificate"/waiver of cooling off, as the case may be, from the parent department/present employer must be furnished at the time of interview. No TA/DA shall be paid to the short-listed candidate for attending the interview, if any.

rows.details: Advertisement for Member (Water Supply) and Member (Drainage)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the DJB Member posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement, which is about 2 December 2026 counting from 2 November 2026; late applications shall not be entertained.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for Member (Water Supply) in Delhi Jal Board?
faq.answer: A serving officer who is an engineer drawing pay not less than that of a Joint Secretary to the Government of India, with specialized knowledge and experience in matters relating to water supply.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for Member (Drainage) in Delhi Jal Board?
faq.answer: A serving officer who is an engineer drawing pay scale not less than that of a Joint Secretary to the Government of India, with specialized knowledge and experience in matters related to drainage.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of DJB Member posts?
faq.answer: Both posts are in Level 14 of the Pay Matrix under the 7th Central Pay Commission (₹1,44,200–₹2,18,200), with DA/HRA and other allowances as admissible to the employees of the Corporation.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for DJB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed proforma through proper channel, offline, to the Director (A&P), Delhi Jal Board, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, 2nd Floor, Room No. 202, Varunalaya Phase-II, Jhandewalan, Karol Bagh, Delhi-110005.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for DJB Member posts?
faq.answer: The Screening Committee will adopt its own criteria for holding the interview; meeting the qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is the DJB Member post permanent?
faq.answer: No, nomination is initially for three years, and the nominated officer is termed on deputation under standard terms and conditions of deputation.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for both Member (Water Supply) and Member (Drainage)?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application should be submitted for each post.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the DJB interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA shall be paid to short-listed candidates for attending the interview, if any.
